name: Vim
summary: Vim allows AI help with contributions only within limits: contributors must disclose AI use with an Assisted-by trailer, remain fully responsible for and able to explain every line they submit, and avoid large mostly-generated pull requests. Generated commit messages, PR descriptions and reviews are not acceptable, though fixing spelling, grammar and translations is fine; AI use in bug reports is not addressed.

evidence.quote: Use of AI is allowed within the limits mentioned below, but you remain fully responsible for everything you submit. Disclosure of AI use is required, using an `Assisted-by:` trailer.
You must understand every line of your change and be able to explain it.
You must have the right to submit the code under the Vim license.
Large pull requests that were mostly generated. We may close pull requests that are too large to review with confidence, whatever their origin.
Generated commit messages or PR descriptions. Write them yourself that ensures you have a good understanding of the change.
Answering review questions by pasting AI output. Reviewers want to hear your own understanding of the change.
Posting AI-generated reviews on other people's pull requests. Automated CI checks are fine.
